title: 第11章农村日常1-《穿越60带着空间当保安》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一等就是大半个小时，随着锅里的香味越来越浓，三个弟弟就围在锅台边大口的吸着气。

    王野熄灭了灶膛里的火，用布垫着掀开锅盖，一阵白色的雾气升腾而起，伴随着浓郁的香气弥漫开来。锅中的食物色泽诱人，几个弟弟眼睛都看直了，口水不停地在口中打转。

    “哥，怎么这么香？”最小的弟弟忍不住问道。

    “别急，先盛出来再说。”王野笑着说道，随后熟练地将锅中的食物盛进盆，三个弟弟像跟屁虫一样跟着王野将盆端上桌。

    王野笑着对爷爷说：“爷爷，这么香的菜你不喝点？”

    爷爷看着菜眼睛都不转了：“喝点，肯定得喝点。”

    说着进屋拿碗给自己打了一碗酒，还给太爷爷打了半碗：“爹，这么好的菜，您老爷喝点儿。”

    太爷爷骂道：“你个王八犊子，你自己一碗，我就半碗，你可真孝顺呀！”

    爷爷耐心解释：“爹，咱说话得讲理，您都多大岁数了，喝这半碗都多。”

    老爷子“哼“一声不再理爷爷。

    王野四下寻找问：“爷爷，小兰呢？”

    爷爷平淡开口：”没过来，应该还在他家呢！”

    王野略微不高兴了：“不是说小的都过来吗？”

    说完就趴在二叔家的墙沿儿上喊：“小兰，小兰。”

    王兰从屋里出来：“大哥，什么事儿呀？”

    王野皱眉道：“大哥叫吃饭你怎么不过来？”

    王兰看了一眼王野，又把头低下去了：“大哥，我吃过了。”

    王野佯怒：“怎么着，这是长大了胆儿肥了，敢和大哥撒谎了是吧？就这半人高的院墙，你当你大哥瞎呀！”

    王兰看大哥急了，赶紧摇头：“不是不是。”

    王野装作一副不耐烦的样子：“怎么个不是，是你不是，还是我不是呀，赶紧给我过来。”

    王兰看着跟出来的父母，二叔说：“去吧，你大哥心疼你，你记在心里就好。”

    王野笑了笑：“二叔说什么呢，一家人不说两家话。”

    一家人落座，三个弟弟每人一碗肉，现在的孩子没有大人的允许，都不会自己去夹菜，只会吃自己碗里的，没了大人给盛就继续吃，大人不给盛，那就是只有这么多。这都是没粮闹得。

    因为放开了让孩子随便吃那是会出人命的。现在的孩子都是张嘴兽，给多少都吃，撑着了更麻烦，还有就是粮食就那么一点，精打细算着都不够，要是家里的壮劳力没饭吃，是真能饿死人的。

    王兰挨着王野，就在那儿吃着手里的窝头，也不夹菜，王野给她一块儿她吃一块儿。

    王野心想：“这可不行呀，这妹妹性格这么柔弱，要是结婚了，这不得让婆家欺负死呀！不行，得练，妹妹的性格得练，不能说练的泼辣，也不能这么柔弱。”

    王野面色带了一丝严肃：“小兰，你都多大了，要不要大哥喂你吃，我给你一块儿你就吃一口，不给你就自己啃窝头。自己夹菜。我看着你夹。”

    爷爷奶奶也知道王野的心思，都不插话。王兰眼睛红红的，开始自己夹菜，低着脑袋吃饭。

    吃完饭，王兰开始收拾碗筷，这也是规矩，现在的男人别指望会去做饭刷碗洗衣服，这样的会被外人笑话，说自己的婆娘是个好吃懒做的货色。自己的男人也在外面直不起腰来。所以一般家里的女孩儿从小就开始锻炼做家务。要不连婆家都找不到。

    这时三爷爷拎着一只兔子来到了爷爷家。进门先跟太爷爷打招呼：“叔。”

    太爷爷抬头：“老三来啦，这是有事儿？”

    三爷爷提了提手里的东西：“这是小野放我那儿的兔子，我给拿过来了。”

    太爷爷摆了摆手：“给你你就留着，你教他本事，还不能让他孝敬你一只兔子啦！”

    三爷爷一脸为难：“可是……”
    第(1/3)页

After waiting for more than half an hour, as the aroma in the pot became stronger and stronger, the three brothers gathered around the pot and took a big breath.

Wang Ye extinguished the fire in the stove and lifted the lid of the pot with a cloth. A burst of white mist rose up, accompanied by a rich aroma.The color of the food in the pot was so attractive that the younger brothers stared at it with saliva flowing in their mouths.

"Brother, why does it smell so good?" the youngest brother couldn't help but ask.

"Don't worry, put it out first." Wang Ye said with a smile, and then skillfully put the food in the pot into the basin. The three younger brothers followed Wang Ye like followers and brought the basin to the table.

Wang Ye smiled and said to his grandfather: "Grandpa, don't you drink some of such fragrant dishes?"

Grandpa looked at the dishes without moving his eyes: "Drink some, you must drink some."

With that said, he went into the house and took a bowl to drink a bowl of wine for himself, and also poured half a bowl for his great-grandfather: "Dad, such a good dish, please drink some."

Grandpa scolded: "You bastard, you have one bowl for yourself and I have half a bowl. You are so filial!"

Grandpa explained patiently: "Dad, let's be reasonable. No matter how old you are, you can drink more than half a bowl."

The old man said "hum" and ignored grandpa.

Wang Ye looked around and asked, "Grandpa, where is Xiaolan?"

Grandpa said calmly: "I haven't come here, I should still be at his house!"

Wang Ye was slightly unhappy: "Didn't you say that all the young ones would come over?"

After saying that, he lay on the edge of the wall of his second uncle’s house and shouted: “Xiaolan, Xiaolan.”

Wang Lan came out of the room: "Brother, what's going on?"

Wang Ye frowned and said, "Why didn't you come over when my elder brother asked me for dinner?"

Wang Lan glanced at Wang Ye and lowered her head: "Brother, I have eaten."

Wang Ye feigned anger: "What's the matter? You've grown up and become bold, and you dare to lie to your eldest brother, right? With a courtyard wall that's half a man tall, you think your eldest brother is blind!"

Wang Lan saw that her elder brother was anxious and quickly shook her head: "No, no."

Wang Ye pretended to be impatient: "Why not? It's you or me. Come here quickly."

Wang Lan looked at her parents who had followed them out, and her second uncle said, "Go, your eldest brother feels sorry for you, just keep it in your heart."

Wang Ye smiled: "What did the second uncle say? One family does not speak the same language as the other."

The family sat down, and each of the three younger brothers had a bowl of meat. Today's children will not pick up the food without the permission of the adults. They will only eat what is in their own bowls. If the adults don't serve it, they will continue to eat. If the adults don't serve it, then there is only so much.This is all caused by lack of food.

Because if you let your children eat whatever they want, it will kill someone.Today's children are all mouthy beasts. They eat whatever is given to them, which makes it even more troublesome to hold on. Moreover, there is only so little food, which is not enough even if you calculate carefully. If the strong working people in the family have no food, they will really starve to death.

Wang Lan was next to Wang Ye, eating the steamed bun in his hand without adding vegetables. Wang Ye gave her a piece and she ate a piece.

Wang Ye thought: "This is not possible. This sister has such a weak character. If she gets married, she will not be bullied to death by her husband's family! No, it must be practiced. My sister's character must be trained. I can't say that I can be fierce or so weak."

Wang Ye's face had a hint of seriousness: "Xiaolan, how old are you? Do you want me to feed you? If I give you a piece, you can take a bite. If I don't give it to you, you can eat the steamed buns by yourself. Pick up the vegetables yourself. I'll watch you pick them up."

The grandparents also knew Wang Ye’s thoughts and did not interrupt.Wang Lan's eyes were red, and she started to pick up her own food, lowering her head to eat.

After dinner, Wang Lan started to clear away the dishes. This is also the rule. Nowadays, men should not expect to cook, wash dishes and wash clothes. If they do, they will be laughed at by outsiders, saying that their mother-in-law is a lazy person.My own man can't straighten up outside either.Therefore, girls in general families start to practice doing housework from an early age.Otherwise, I can’t even find my husband’s family.

At this time, the third grandpa came to grandpa’s house carrying a rabbit.When entering the door, greet your great-grandfather first: "Uncle."

Grandpa looked up and said, "The third child is here. Is something wrong?"

Third Grandpa picked up the thing in his hand: "This is the rabbit Xiaoye put me there, I brought it over."

Grandpa waved his hand: "You can keep it if I give it to you. If you teach him his skills, you can't let him treat you like a rabbit!"

Third Grandpa looked embarrassed: "But..."
